title: (Pwn2Own) Oracle Autonomous AI Database APEX Workspace Resolution Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass a validation check on affected installations of Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the APEX workspace administration page's before-render processing. The issue results from the lack of proper handling of error conditions. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to bypass authentication on the system.
addtionnal_details:
Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cspunov2026.html
